name: Uribel
source:
A gentle elemental spirit of water. He values all life and is a pacifist.

Yrsa feels he's just another person she has to protect, but could he become more than that to her, even without being able to fight?

[from [url=https://shibalist.itch.io/yrsa-major]itch.io[/url]]
